newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Feb PPI confirms a growing path -EconMin.
newsitem.headline: Spain Feb PPI confirms a growing path -EconMin.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry said on Monday that February industrial production data showed that the positive trend from 1996 continues.
The National Statistic institute reported on Monday that Spain's industrial production fell a yearly 0.3 percent versus a 2.8 percent revised gain in January.
Calendar-adjusted data rose 1.9 percent year-on-year versus 5.0 percent.

"This data, together with the favourable trend in January, reflect a very positive trend of industrial production, especially given the possible negative impact from the truckers strike in February," a note from the Economy Ministry said.
